svg.data-weight: 31.1 kg (68.6 lb) with four AC supplies and three fan modules fitted; 30.8 kg (67.8 lb) for the DC build (Table 30)
svg.data-mounting: four-post rack kit in the box; spare kits EX4500-4PST-RMK
svg.data-throughput: 5.76 Tbps and 2 Bpps of forwarding capacity (Q5 ASICs); 288 x 10 GbE, 72 x 40 GbE or 24 x 100 GbE ports (Table 2)
svg.data-packet-buffer: deep buffer from hybrid memory cubes (HMC)
svg.data-psu-ac-input: 100 to 127 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC at 50 to 60 Hz, 12.9 A at 100-120 VAC (Table 21); each supply has one input
svg.data-psu-dc-input: -48 to -60 VDC rated, -40 to -72 VDC operating range, 40 A maximum; a 40 A breaker is recommended
svg.data-psu-redundancy: four bays, 2N recommended; one supply at 220 VAC or two at 110 VAC run the 72Q
svg.data-heat-dissipation: 3,583 BTU/hr typical and 4,862 BTU/hr maximum (Tables 21 and 25)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 40 C (32 F to 104 F)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C (-40 F to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing; short term 5 to 93 percent
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft)
svg.data-storage: two 25 GB SSDs (the hardware inventory text also names a 25 GB NAND flash drive)
svg.data-asic: Q5 packet forwarding ASICs with hybrid memory cubes
svg.data-timing: 1PPS and 10 MHz SMB connectors and a PTP Ethernet SFP port
svg.data-seismic: Designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements per NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3

g.data-description: The upper band, 36 QSFP+ ports numbered 0 to 35, the even port above the odd. g.data-description: Table 14 - status lamp: green steady at 1000 Mbps, unlit at 10 Mbps or no link. Link and activity lamp: yellow blinking with activity, unlit with no link
g.title: mgmt

g.data-function: reset the hardware (press and hold 5 seconds; clock functions and FPGA status registers are not reset)
g.title: reset

g.data-description: Table 15 - green steady: link up and no activity; green blinking: link and activity; unlit: no link
g.title: led-mgmt-sfp

g.data-description: the link and activity lamps of the two SFP ports (Table 15)
g.title: led-ptp-sfp

g.data-description: Table 16 - green steady: power is working correctly; yellow blinking: a problem with chassis power; unlit: no power
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: Table 16 - green steady: Junos OS is loaded; green blinking: the beacon feature is enabled; yellow blinking: a fault is detected; unlit: powered off or halted
g.title: led-sta

g.data-description: Table 16 - red steady: a major hardware fault such as a temperature alarm or power failure, and the switch has halted; unlit: no major alarm
g.title: led-mjr

g.data-description: Table 16 - yellow steady: a minor alarm such as a software error; unlit: no minor alarm
g.title: led-mnr

g.data-description: the front laser-radiation warning
g.title: laser-warning
